name: Sunrise
source:
A decades-long project can extend Earth's expiration date, or snuff it out entirely. No pressure.

In a tumultuous world, you've learned to live in fear. Protect what little you have, because it can all be taken away. Everybody knows what happens when you fly too close to the sun.

Against your better judgement, you now have a house guest. Some would say you're harboring a fugitive. That's just a matter of perspective. 

He's short on answers, and raises too many questions. He's brash, crude, and smarter than he looks. Is he flirting, or just using you?

Can this partnership survive on fleeting feelings of trust?

What isn't he telling you? 

Can you discover his secrets without revealing your own lies?

Do whatever is necessary to survive. Hide your true feelings, misuse alien technology, explore each other's bodies, and betray your government like it's going out of style.

You're running out of resources, running out of time. You can't hide forever. You'll have to come out and face apocalypse, whether you like it or not.

Rise and shine cupcake, the future is now.

[From [url=https://lazuriteraccoon.itch.io/project-sunrise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个长达数十年的项目可以延长地球的寿命，或者完全消灭它。没有压力。

在一个动荡的世界里，你学会了生活在恐惧之中。保护你仅有的一点点，因为它都可能被夺走。每个人都知道当你飞得离太阳太近时会发生什么。

与你更好的判断相反，你现在有一位客​​人。有人会说你窝藏逃犯。这只是一个视角问题。

他缺乏答案，却提出了太多问题。他傲慢、粗鲁，但比他看上去更聪明。他是在调情，还是只是在利用你？

这种伙伴关系能否靠短暂的信任感维持下去？

他没有告诉你什么？

你能在不揭穿自己谎言的情况下发现他的秘密吗？

为了生存，做任何必要的事情。隐藏你的真实感受，滥用外星技术，探索彼此的身体，背叛你的政府，就像它已经过时一样。

你的资源即将耗尽，时间也即将耗尽。你不可能永远隐藏。无论你喜欢与否，你都必须走出来面对世界末日。

崛起并闪耀纸杯蛋糕，未来就在眼前。

[来自[url=https://lazuriteraccoon.itch.io/project-sunrise]Itch.io[/url]]
